PROCESS & CREDITS

Made with intention.

Project lead: Shivam Gupta.

OpenAI Codex assisted with concept development, code, automation, documentation and review. Original geometry, materials and mathematically synthesized audio were made for this project. Motion is scripted and baked into the Blender scene.

Space Grotesk by Florian Karsten is used under SIL Open Font License 1.1. Blender, Python and FFmpeg power production. Rendering uses this studio's own cloud workers.

No stock models, recorded music, generative video, physical simulation or sponsor endorsement is claimed.
